name: [250] Kill Your Friend!
desc:
💀 KILL YOUR FRIEND 💀

🎯 250 LEVELS, 25 WORLDS!
👤 MAKE IT PERSONAL: swap the bacon for one of your Roblox friends
🌋 NATURAL DISASTERS: tsunami, tornado, meteor shower, black hole and more
🔫 LASER BLASTER: zap other players
🏆 RANKS AND BADGES: climb from Innocent all the way to Friendless

Cross the bridge to the next island and do it all again.

⭐ Join the group for free skips!
👍 Enjoying the game? Leave a like and a favourite!

llm.loop: pick a level -> use traps (anvil, hammer, disasters) to kill the 'friend' NPC -> next level across 25 worlds
llm.objectives: clear 250 levels of ways to kill your friend
llm.progression: levels, worlds, ranks Innocent to Friendless
llm.instructions: swap the target for a Roblox friend, kill them with traps and disasters, advance islands
unique: uses your real friend's avatar as the victim
llm.thumbnails: giant yellow hand menacing a scared bacon; anvil and hammer gags; 'Free UGC'
llm.complexity_notes: many small levels, ragdoll physics, avatar loading
